ramen_ca_8b54514b80ab0ad1c9a8.editorialDescription: Upstairs on Whistler Way, Ohyama balances mountain-town appetite with a menu that can be tuned by seasoning and portion. The Classic, Meat Lover and Big Mountain bowls each allow shio, shoyu or miso, moving from an accessible $17.50 starting point to the $25 largest option. Diners avoiding animal ingredients have a clearly named Creamy Vegan bowl rather than a modification request. The dated June menu includes warm-weather alternatives such as tomato and yuzu cold ramen, while Tan Tan Noodles adds a sesame-oriented direction. The homepage checked on October 21 lists an 8:45 p.m. takeout cutoff and a 10 p.m. dine-in close. The older weekly schedule has a separate evidence date; confirm the service you need before an evening trip.
ramen_ca_8b54514b80ab0ad1c9a8.visitTips: The October 21 homepage lists takeout until 8:45 p.m. and dine-in until 10 p.m. Confirm seasonal hours and the June menu’s availability before travelling.
